concerns: Mentions test automation — be ready to discuss it or show a small script
Listed range is for another country
requirements: At least 3 years of experience in QA, SDET, or test automation, building or delivering test suites and automation frameworks.
Strong Go experience writing integration tests or backend test automation, plus experience creating end-to-end tests for web UIs.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, React, RPC protocols such as gRPC, CI/CD systems, and Linux fundamentals.
Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Alertmanager, or Grafana.
Experience with LLM-powered or conversational products, agent evaluations, multicluster tooling, Kubernetes testing, or chaos engineering is helpful.
Exposure to Playwright or similar frameworks, Slack apps, GPU or bare-metal infrastructure, and building test infrastructure from scratch is a plus.
responsibilities: Join an early-stage AI infrastructure company as its first QA engineer, owning quality across a GPU fleet management platform. You will help ensure that conversational and web interfaces, along with the underlying Kubernetes systems, handle infrastructure changes safely and reliably.
Test conversational workflows end to end, including command accuracy and actions performed on live clusters.
Build evaluations for agent behavior, checking answer quality, safe actions, and handling of ambiguous or invalid requests.
Create end-to-end tests for the web interface and verify consistent behavior across interfaces.
Write Go integration tests for backend workflows, including installation, upgrades, and failover.
Provision and tear down Kubernetes test clusters to validate controllers, operators, and CRDs across Kubernetes versions.
Verify alert delivery to collaboration tools and the user interface, and confirm alerts fire under the right conditions.
